gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 23:35:56 GMT 2026
DELETED o2: Undeclared exception!
DELETED o4: Undeclared exception!
ADDED i2: printerFor() returns a non-null Printer for a document backed by a file writer.
ADDED i3: traverse() with an Outline visitor returns the same document instance it started on.
ADDED i4: Outline.shouldIndent() returns false for a CDATA node (CDATA is never indented).
ADDED i5: addTail() with preserveWhitespace enabled leaves the document id unchanged (empty).
ADDED i6: A body fragment renders with outline mode enabled.
ADDED i7: addText() on an orphan CDATA node throws NPE from Entities (no settings available).
ADDED i9: hasNonTextNodes() returns false when the inspected children are text/CDATA nodes.
ADDED i10: Pretty.addText() on a re-parented text node keeps the node attached to its parent.
ADDED i11: Repeated prependElement() places each new element before the existing shell content.
ADDED i12: addHead() rejects a negative depth with an IllegalArgumentException from Validate.
ADDED i14: Renaming the root tag then appending text yields the shell followed by the loose text.
ADDED i15: A document-level comment and trailing text render after the shell, each on its own line.
ADDED i16: traverse() with a Pretty visitor returns the same CDATA node it started on.
ADDED i17: Appending markup and then text renders both directly after the shell.
ADDED i18: Parsing already-formatted markup re-pretty-prints it with the inline elements together.
ADDED i19: prependText() on a body fragment renders the loose text before the generated shell.
ADDED i20: Parsing text containing an unclosed angle-bracket token produces a synthesised closing tag.
ADDED i21: Setting a title renders it inside the head section.
ADDED i22: When the PreserveWhitespace tag flag is altered, the shell renders without pretty indentation.
